payload.posture: Read Acts 7:54–60 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states as the council reacts, Stephen sees God’s glory and Jesus standing at God’s right hand, names what he sees, is driven out and stoned, and addresses Jesus while dying. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
